select minimum_sample_count as minimumSampleCount, window_days as windowDays, neutral_minimum_score as neutralMinimumScore, safe_minimum_score as safeMinimumScore from merchant_safety_policy where status = 1 order by id desc limit 1

select count(*) as sample_count, avg(case r.overall_level when 'SAFE' then 3 when 'NEUTRAL' then 2 else 1 end) as average_score, max(r.create_time) as latest_at from merchant_safety_rating r join ( select member_id, max(id) as latest_id from merchant_safety_rating where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and create_time >= #{cutoff} group by member_id ) latest on latest.latest_id = r.id

select d.dimension_code, count(distinct r.member_id) as sample_count, avg(case d.level when 'SAFE' then 3 when 'NEUTRAL' then 2 else 1 end) as average_score from merchant_safety_rating_dimension d inner join merchant_safety_rating r on r.id = d.rating_id inner join ( select member_id, max(id) as latest_id from merchant_safety_rating where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and create_time >= #{cutoff} group by member_id ) latest on latest.latest_id = r.id group by d.dimension_code order by d.dimension_code
